# pai registry

Maintain the project registry: scan, stats, rebuild

```
pai registry <command>
```

Maintain the project registry: scan, stats, rebuild.

```sh
pai registry stats
pai registry scan --quick
```

### pai registry scan

Find projects on disk and register them

```
pai registry scan [options]
```

Find projects on disk and register them.

Walk ~/.claude/projects/ and configured scan_dirs, upsert all projects

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--add-dir PATH` | string | — | Add a directory to scan_dirs config |
| `--remove-dir PATH` | string | — | Remove a directory from scan_dirs config |
| `--show-dirs` | flag | — | Show currently configured scan directories |
| `--quick` | flag | — | Minimal output mode (used by hooks and daemon) |
| `--filter-report` | flag | — | Dry run: count existing registry rows that match the worker/temp/worktree filter; deletes nothing |

```sh
pai registry scan
pai registry scan --show-dirs
```

See also: `pai registry migrate`

### pai registry rebuild

Erase the registry and rebuild it from disk (destructive)

```
pai registry rebuild [options]
```

Erase the registry and rebuild it from disk (destructive).

Erase all registry data and rebuild from the filesystem (destructive)

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--yes` | flag | — | Confirm the erase (without it nothing is deleted and the command exits 1) |

```sh
pai registry rebuild
pai registry rebuild --yes
```

See also: `pai registry dedupe`, `pai registry stats`, `pai memory repair-orphans`

### pai registry dedupe

Merge registry rows that describe the same project

```
pai registry dedupe [options]
```

Merge registry rows that describe the same project.

Merge registry rows that describe the same project.
Two spellings of one directory (e.g. via a symlinked path prefix) register
as separate projects and split session history between them. Rows are grouped
by resolved path, so a merge only happens when the paths are provably identical.
Dry-run by default; --execute backs up the registry first and merges in one transaction.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--execute` | flag | — | Actually perform the merge (default is dry-run) |

```sh
pai registry dedupe
pai registry dedupe --execute
```

See also: `pai registry reconnect`, `pai registry rebuild`

### pai registry reconnect

Reconnect projects to transcripts they lost

```
pai registry reconnect [options]
```

Reconnect projects to transcripts they lost.

Point projects back at the transcripts they lost.
A project's encoded_dir is written once and never updated when the project
moves, so handovers, session digests and checkpoints silently find nothing.
Repairs are read from the transcripts themselves — each records the cwd it ran
in — rather than re-derived from the naming rule that broke.
Dry-run by default; --execute writes the corrected rows in one transaction.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--execute` | flag | — | Actually write the corrections (default is dry-run) |

```sh
pai registry reconnect
pai registry reconnect --execute
```

See also: `pai registry lookup`, `pai registry dedupe`

### pai registry lookup

Print the project name for a folder (for scripts)

```
pai registry lookup [options]
```

Print the project name for a folder (for scripts).

Find the project slug for a filesystem path (for use in scripts)

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path PATH` | string | — | Filesystem path to look up |

```sh
pai registry lookup --path ~/code/my-app
pai registry lookup --path .
```

See also: `pai registry reconnect`
